claims.claim_ar: تعين الحقيقة بتأشيرها وذكرها بـ «بِالْحَقِّ» (إشارة + تعريف)، أي توكيد وتعيين الحق رداً على تكذيبهم.
claims.claim_en: Specification/emphatic designation of 'the Truth' by the demonstrative phrase 'هذا بِالْحَقِّ' (demonstrative + 'bi-'), i.e. marking and affirming the truth in rebuttal to their denial.

claims.claim_ar: حرف العطف في مستهل الجملة (فـ/واو) يعمل كأداة استئناف ووصْل بين الكلام السابق وهذه الآية، مؤكّداً انتقال الخُطاب ونتيجته.
claims.claim_en: The conjunction at the start of the clause (fa-/wa-) functions as a resumptive/connecting particle, linking the preceding discourse to this verse and emphasizing the transition to the resulting statement.
claims.needs_review_reason: The cited commentary explicitly treats conjunctive particles (mentions 'الواو استئنافية') — applying that observation to the initial 'فـ' in this ayah is an informed inference and should be checked against sources that discuss 'فـ' in the same syntactic/rhetorical role.

warnings: Claim 1 is based on al-Kashshaf's explicit remark about the phrase 'أَلَيْسَ هذا بِالْحَقِّ' (used here to justify treating بِالْحَقِّ as a device of تعيين); this maps directly to word_index 3 (بِالْحَقِّ).

Claim 2 generalizes a commentary about resumptive conjunctions ('الواو استئنافية، والكلام مستأنف') to the initial 'فـ' in this verse (فَقَدْ). That inference is reasonable but not quoted verbatim for 'فـ' in the provided chunks — recommend reviewing additional commentary that treats 'فـ' specifically as استئناف/وصل in this verse.
